text:
To fix the `Permission denied` issue with NAS bind mounts on UGOS (as well as Synology and unRAID), you need to ensure the container's user and group IDs match your host filesystem permissions.

### Solution
Set the `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID` and `HERMES_GID`) environment variables on your Docker container to match the UID and GID of the host user that owns the mounted directory.

For example, when running your container:
```bash
docker run -it \
  -e PUID=$(id -u) \
  -e PGID=$(id -g) \
  -v /path/to/host/data:/opt/data \
  nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest
```
*(Alternatively, you can pass `-e HERMES_UID=<host_uid> -e HERMES_GID=<host_gid>`)*.
